audit_items.proof_trace: The hot-potato pattern guarantees the fee is always paid: repay_flash_loan asserts coin.value() == amount + fee (L837), and fee != 0 is asserted at borrow time (L814). However, the specific rate is governance-controlled per emode group (not hardcoded to 0.1%) and the caller selects the emode_group, meaning whitelisted callers can pick any valid group's rate — this is intentional protocol design, not a bypass, and flash loan access is already gated to AdminCap-issued PackageCallerCap holders.
